nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/

│   └── 📂 text_encoders/

```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

state.prompt:
subject_definitions:
@image1 is Varek. @image2 is Sena. @image3 is the location, a flooded derelict turbine hall, and gives the light. @audio1 is Varek's voice: use its timbre, pitch and accent only, and do not reuse any of its words. @audio2 is Sena's voice: use its timbre, pitch and accent only, and do not reuse any of its words. The only spoken words in the video are the two lines written below.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] Varek and Sena exchange two lines in the turbine hall, then Sena walks toward the far doorway and the camera follows her.

detailed_description:
Grounded sci-fi thriller, photoreal, cold daylight falling from the high windows into dim tungsten, wet concrete and rust everywhere.

[Shot 1] Sena start walking

overall_soundscape:
Cavernous room tone, water dripping into standing pools, a distant structural groan of metal. Varek's respirator hisses and clicks between lines. Sena's boots hit wet grit in a steady rhythm that carries to the end of the video, with dripping water and one long low metal groan filling the last seconds. No other voices anywhere in the video.

non_diegetic_music:
A low sustained synth drone under the dialogue, almost still. A slow bass pulse enters as she starts walking and holds one note through to the end.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is Sena. @image2 is the location, a vast turbine hall with an enormous fan at the far end, and gives the light. 

summary:
[reference generation + video continuation] Sena walks into the fan hall.

detailed_description:
Grounded sci-fi thriller, photoreal, anamorphic, deep shadow cut by one shaft of pale daylight from above, wet concrete and drifting dust.

[Shot 1] The video opens with Sena already walking at a steady pace, mid-stride, continuing the movement and framing of @video1 with no acceleration from rest. She walks past the entrance down the central aisle of @image2, The camera Tracks behind her with large amplitude at slow speed the whole way, then settles as she stops.


overall_soundscape:
Huge reverberant room tone. Her boots on wet concrete, steady, echoing off the far walls. A deep slow rotation of the fan blades rising into a low rhythmic wash as she gets closer, with water dripping and distant metal creaking throughout. In the close-up her breathing sits close and slow over the blade wash, and one last drip lands as the video ends. No voices anywhere in the video.

non_diegetic_music:
A sub-bass drone pulsing in time with the blade rotation. One sustained string note enters at the close-up and holds without resolving.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is Sena. 
@image2 is Varek.
@image3 is the location, the turbine hall, and gives the light and the background. @video1 is how the scene look. 
@audio1 is Varek's voice: use its timbre, pitch and accent only, and do not reuse any of its words. The only spoken words in the video are the one line written below.

summary:
[reference generation + video continuation + audio reference] Sena concentrates in close-up and the turbine accelerates around her, then the video cuts to Varek in close-up saying one line.

detailed_description:
Grounded sci-fi thriller, photoreal, anamorphic, shallow focus, deep shadow cut by hard pale light off the turbine, heavy dust in the air, one person in frame at a time.

[Shot 1] Sena turns away, camera pushes back


overall_soundscape:
A deep blade wash that climbs steadily in speed and pitch into a full roar, with metal groaning under load and cables singing as it builds. Wind and grit across the microphone throughout. For the whole first shot the only human sound is Sena's strained breathing through her nose, close on the microphone, with no words anywhere in it. 
non_diegetic_music:
A sub-bass drone rising in step with the blade rate. Low strings enter under the cut and hold one unresolved chord beneath his line.
